snippet.title: Beetlebum - Insect-themed classic survival horror game with pre-rendered, PSX-style backgrounds!
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io https://menacingmecha.itch.io/beetlebum?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt Beetlebum is an insect-themed, classic survival horror demo with pre-rendered backgrounds.

On a long night drive through the countryside, you fell asleep at the wheel.

You awake to find yourself in an unfamiliar location, as well as in an unfamiliar body.

You must escape.

➡️ More from Callum Mackay https://menacingmecha.itch.io/?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt
